speaker: Professor Elm
lines: Welcome to the world of Creature Chronicles!
I am Professor Elm, a researcher studying the bond between humans and creatures.
In our world, creatures roam freely — some in harmony with humans, others wild and untamed.
Three factions debate the future of this relationship...

prompt: Professor Elm: Choose your first companion!

speaker: Professor Elm
lines: Ah, Emberpup! A bold choice. This little one's loyalty burns as bright as its tail.
Take good care of each other.

speaker: Professor Elm
lines: Tidalette! A wonderful companion. Its playful nature hides great depths of power.
I know you two will make great partners.

speaker: Professor Elm
lines: Sproutling! A gentle soul with the strength of ancient forests.
Together, you'll grow into something extraordinary.

speaker: Professor Elm
lines: Here, take these supplies for your journey.
Head east through Verdant Path to reach Crestfall Village.
Along the way, you'll encounter wild creatures. You can befriend them using Befriend Crystals!
But first... it seems someone wants to test your skills.

speaker: Kael
lines: Hey! I heard you got a creature from the Professor too.
Name's Kael. I picked my partner yesterday.
How about a quick battle? I want to see what you're made of!

speaker: Kael
lines: Not bad! You and your creature make a good team.
I'll be training hard. Next time we meet, I won't lose!
See you on the road!

speaker: Kael
lines: Ha! Looks like I've got the edge for now.
Don't worry — every tamer stumbles at first. Keep training!
See you around!

speaker: Professor Elm
lines: That was a fine battle!
Now, head east to Crestfall Village. Captain Stone runs the first official challenge there.
Along the way, pay attention to the wild creatures you encounter.
And remember — the bond between tamer and creature is the most powerful force in our world.

speaker: Bug Catcher Tim
lines: Hey there! I love bug-type creatures!
Let's battle!

speaker: Hiker Bob
lines: Nothing like a good hike and a battle!
My rock creatures are tough!

speaker: Elder Sage
lines: Young tamer, welcome to Crestfall Village.
I see you've already begun your journey with a creature companion.
In our world, three factions hold different beliefs about the creature-human bond:

prompt: Elder Sage: Which philosophy resonates with you?

choices.text: Harmony — Mutual partnership is the way
Dominion — Creature power should advance humanity

speaker: Elder Sage
lines: A compassionate view. The Liberation Front believes creatures deserve autonomy.
Their leader, Sage Lyra, would be pleased to hear that.
Remember — your actions throughout your journey will shape your alignment.

speaker: Elder Sage
lines: The balanced path. The Harmony Guild believes in mutual respect and partnership.
Their leader, Commander Ash, has always championed cooperation.
Your journey will test this belief many times.

speaker: Elder Sage
lines: An ambitious perspective. The Dominion Order seeks to harness creature power for progress.
Director Volt leads them with a vision of a stronger humanity.
Be mindful — power without wisdom can lead to ruin.

speaker: Elder Sage
lines: Before you continue your journey, you should challenge Captain Stone.
He tests aspiring tamers at the village arena. Defeat him to earn your first badge.

speaker: Captain Stone
lines: So, you want to challenge me?
I am Captain Stone, guardian of Crestfall Village.
My rock-type creatures are as unyielding as the mountains themselves!
Show me the strength of your bond!

speaker: Captain Stone
lines: Incredible! Your bond with your creature is truly remarkable.
Take this — the Stone Badge, proof of your victory.
And this key — it opens the path to the Whispering Woods to the south.
New routes are now open to you. The world awaits, young tamer!

speaker: Captain Stone
lines: A valiant effort, but you're not ready yet.
Train more and come back when you're stronger!

description: Chapter 1 Complete! You've earned your first badge and the world is opening up before you.
